masterInitial.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished original detailed pixel-art concept comparison board for Võ Lâm Hero Defense, arena enemies waves 09–12, concept only. Follow the attached APPROVED reference art, not generic fantasy. Image1 and2: approved preceding concept sheets, style and layout standard. Image3: Wave7 skeleton design lineage, skull, aged ivory bones, teal rags, bronze, straight rusted Chinese jian. Image4: ACTUAL production sprites beside Cái Bang, authoritative compact pixel density/scale/camera reference. Image5: actual Wave7 production atlas, family reference only, do NOT generate an atlas.
Landscape board, warm ivory background, four roomy horizontal rows, original high-quality 2D pixel art with deliberate visible square pixels, crisp dark brown/charcoal thin stepped outlines, clustered 3–5-tone material shading, upper-left warm light, modest ground shadows. Same chibi compact proportions and elevated orthographic top-down three-quarter overworld camera as references, visible top of skull/shoulders/feet in every facing. Never isometric, eye-level side-scrolling, painterly smooth art, 3D, or crude blocks.
Title exactly "ARENA CREEPS — CONCEPT 09–12". Subtitle "PHASE 1E • CONCEPT ONLY • SCALE APPROXIMATE". Four rows named below. Each row has exactly FOUR full-body neutral directional designs labeled FRONT, BACK, LEFT (faces image-left), RIGHT (faces image-right), one separate full-body ACTION pose, six palette squares with tiny feature/weapon detail callout, and compact SCALE (APPROX.) comparison with Cái Bang in red holding staff, existing Wave7 ivory/teal/bronze skeleton swordsman, and the NEW enemy. ALL views per row same identity, costume, anatomy and weapon hand. Clear margins, entire bodies/weapons inside canvas. Do not crop.
09 Cương Thi / Jiangshi Zombie: normal human height, pale gray/sage skin, glowing green eyes, dark indigo/charcoal long tattered traditional Chinese robe with narrow muted crimson trim and sash, simple dark round Qing-style cap with small crimson top knot, ochre paper talisman dangling on forehead with red ink strokes. Stiff outstretched arms, large readable pale hands, rigid raised shoulders, short dark boots. Front talisman and eyes must be readable small. Back shows cap/robe back, not face or forehead talisman. LEFT/RIGHT show same profile hat and forward stiff arms. ACTION single stiff-arm lunge with only faint green wisps at hands.
10 Oán Linh / Vengeful Spirit: slightly taller floating slender Chinese spectral figure, navy-black long hair framing pale glowing face and blue-green eyes, long torn blue-violet Chinese robes, luminous cobalt/lavender dense body core, strong dark blue-violet contour for grass readability, hands with spectral claw fingers. No legs, lower robe breaks into 3–4 wispy tapering tails; small detached motes. Ethereal but mostly visible, transparency limited to wispy edges. BACK long dark hair and robe tails, no front face. ACTION one outstretched palm forming a small concentrated blue-violet spectral orb; no extra separate skill art.
11 Thiết Giáp Khô Lâu / Armored Skeleton: clearly related to approved Wave7 skull, matching cracked ivory skull proportions/teeth and bone joints, rust bronze and ragged dark teal undercloth. Taller and much broader, dense ancient CHINESE iron/bronze lamellar armor, TWO massive bronze-rimmed shoulder guards, heavy torso and shin plates, exposed skeletal fingers and bone gaps, glowing amber-orange eye sockets. Bare cracked skull visible, no horned helmet. Heavy straight broad Chinese jian, brass crossguard and ring pommel, in character RIGHT hand (FRONT viewer-left, BACK viewer-right). Large rectangular-round-corner bronze/iron shield with Chinese cloud-scroll motif in character LEFT hand (FRONT viewer-right, BACK viewer-left); retain both weapons in all four views, side-view shield edge may be narrow but visible. ACTION overhead heavy downward sword strike, shield braced. Not European knight.
12 Thạch Nhân / Stone Golem: largest regular enemy yet, broad stone guardian inspired by ancient Chinese temple statuary, about 1.5x HERO body height and bulky, not a giant boss. Huge irregular stone arms and fists, short sturdy stone legs, expressive carved stone brow/face, chipped weathered gray/taupe/brown rocks, layered hand-hewn irregular stones, cracks and Chinese cloud-scroll carvings, glowing jade green eyes and central chest seal plus forearm rune fissures. Moss tufts and tiny vegetation anchored on character LEFT shoulder (FRONT viewer-right, BACK viewer-left), same in every view. No armor, clothing, held weapons, robot or Minecraft cubes. BACK carved spinal stones, no chest seal on back. ACTION one heavy fist slam, a few small contact cracks and short subtle jade/stone ripple integrated with the pose, not separate VFX asset.
Scale vignettes: same hero44 logical pixel body height and Wave7 skeleton44, Jiangshi44, spirit approx52 including tails plus small hover gap, armored skeleton54, golem66. These numbers are illustrative proportional CONCEPT targets, not production pixel dimensions; depict ratios visually, do not print technical pixel numbers. Keep hero identical style every row, baseline feet/shadow comparison meaningful. Large neutral character drawings may be enlarged for inspection; palette callouts clear and restrained. New silhouettes instantly different even in monochrome: rigid narrow undead, floating taper, broad sword/shield armored skeleton, massive fists golem.
No animation sequences, atlas cells, bosses, environments, UI, additional enemy designs or redesign of reference characters. One static action drawing per enemy only. Original artwork.
